description: PatchForge Reasoning Failure Dataset — Forensic Analysis of 13 WRONG_HYPOTHESIS Tasks

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed url_for was improperly validating schemes or endpoint strings.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Nested dotted blueprint names were missing recursive dot-splitting in Blueprint.name validation.
cases.ignored_evidence: Blueprint registration hierarchy in Flask app context and test assertion asserting dotted name raises ValueError.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Branch predicate checking if '.' in blueprint.name vs validating during register_blueprint.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed json.loads was failing due to improper kwargs forwarding.
cases.ground_truth_defect: r.json() decoding r.text when content is chunked and contains raw bytes with encoding mismatch.
cases.ignored_evidence: Traceback showed UnicodeDecodeError in r.text getter invoked before json decoding.
cases.missing_causal_signal: First divergence at r.text property call instead of json() parsing logic.
cases.discriminating_variable: self.encoding vs detected charset in r.text

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed click CLI option was not registered on flask routes command.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Table formatting in routes command failed to sort domain/subdomain rules correctly.
cases.ignored_evidence: CLI output string comparison in test_routes showed mismatch in table column ordering.
cases.missing_causal_signal: State mutation where rule table rows are appended without subdomains.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed assertion rewriter was not handling generator expressions.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Unrolling of iterables (all/any) in assertion failure explanation produced unreadable diff.
cases.ignored_evidence: Assertion failure message formatting helper in _pytest.assertion.
cases.missing_causal_signal: First divergence at explanation generator where all() expression elements were truncated.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed fixture manager was dropping fixture scopes from dict.
cases.ground_truth_defect: --fixtures display flag showed 'function' scope when it should be hidden by default unless verbose.
cases.ignored_evidence: Test assertion checking terminal output lines for scope prefix strings.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Branch predicate checking if scope == 'function' before printing scope tag.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed log capture handler was attached to wrong root logger.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Default log_level override was resetting custom handler log level unconditionally.
cases.ignored_evidence: Logging config test showing handler.level altered after fixture setup.
cases.missing_causal_signal: State mutation mutating handler.level without checking if explicitly set by user.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed xml generator was omitting suite attributes.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Hostname and timestamp XML attributes were missing from testsuite root node in junitxml.
cases.ignored_evidence: XML schema validation test asserting attribute presence on root tag.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Trace event at testsuite XML element creation where socket.gethostname() was not called.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed tearDown method was deleted or renamed in TestCase runner.
cases.ground_truth_defect: tearDown was being executed for skipped tests when it should be bypassed if setUp was skipped.
cases.ignored_evidence: unittest test runner hook checking test._outcome.skipped or skipped attribute.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Branch predicate in runtest(): if not skipped: tearDown().

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed fixture teardown generator was raising unhandled exception.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Teardown was being called even if setup was not executed due to skip exception.
cases.ignored_evidence: Hook call runner exception inspection in runner.py.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Trace event checking whether setup phase succeeded before invoking item.teardown().

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed mark decorator was improperly applied to test function.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Dynamically added markers via request.node.add_marker() were not evaluated by xfail runner in time.
cases.ignored_evidence: Test checking xfail evaluation order relative to dynamic marker attachment.
cases.missing_causal_signal: State mutation where own_markers list was not re-queried during evaluation.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed notes checker was skipping comment tokens completely.
cases.ground_truth_defect: --notes option with punctuation (e.g. 'TODO:') was stripped by regex word boundary.
cases.ignored_evidence: Regex pattern using \b boundary which fails on trailing punctuation like ':'.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Regex compilation where re.escape() or non-word-boundary matching should be used.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed module import graph was failing on relative imports.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Checking module folder with same name as a file confused module resolution in expand_modules.
cases.ignored_evidence: os.path.isdir vs os.path.isfile precedence in directory walker.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Branch predicate checking if isdir and has __init__.py before checking .py file.

cases.what_patchforge_believed: Believed configuration parser was not loading regex strings.
cases.ground_truth_defect: Valid regexes containing '\p' triggered regex validation error because re module does not support Unicode property escapes.
cases.ignored_evidence: re.error traceback on pattern compilation in config checker.
cases.missing_causal_signal: Try/except block catching re.error vs regex pre-processing.
cases.discriminating_variable: re.compile with fallback or regex library
